 Inox Wind, Vikram Solar shares plunge up to 10%; check Q2 earnings review
 JM Financial projects 20–22% annual revenue growth and 18–19 per cent margins for Inox wind in FY27 and FY28, while it expects Vikram Solar’s revenue to reach ₹5,570.8 crore in FY27 and ₹9,339.4 crore in FY28.

 AI generated image for representational purposes only. Shares of Inox Wind Ltd and Vikram Solar Ltd declined up to 10 per cent on Monday, reacting to their September quarter (Q2FY27) earnings.
 Inox Wind shares slipped over 10 per cent to hit a low of ₹57.69, taking its market cap down to ₹10,212 crore. Similarly, Vikram Solar plunged as much as 8.85 per cent to a day's low of ₹130.80 on the BSE against its previous close of ₹143.50, slipping its market cap to around ₹4,928 crore.
 Inox Wind Q2 results review 
Reviewing Inox Wind's performance, JM Financial flagged it as "another disappointing quarter" following a fresh margin miss. Q2FY27 revenue grew 21 per cent YoY and 66 per cent QoQ, beating brokerage estimates by 12 per cent, while net profit dropped 43 per cent YoY, missing JM Financial estimates by 33 per cent.
 Advt 
 Inox Wind won 350 MW orders in Q2FY27, taking its October 2026 order book to 3.8 GW versus 4.4 GW in July. Subsidiary Inox Green grew its O&M portfolio to 12.5 GWp after acquiring Wind World India's 4.5 GW wind assets, whose ₹600 crore FY26 revenue will consolidate from Q3FY27. 
 JM Financial noted management's earlier FY27 target of 70–75 per cent revenue growth and 20–22 per cent margin is now "highly unlikely", shifting focus to FY28 guidance of ₹7,500 crore revenue and 20 per cent margin.
For FY27 and FY28, JM Financial projects 20–22 per cent annual revenue growth and 18–19 per cent margins.
 Vikram Solar Q2 results review 
 For Vikram Solar, JM Financial said Q2FY27 results were not as tough as feared, beating muted expectations despite annual declines. Revenue fell 2.9 per cent YoY, topping brokerage estimates by 16.3 per cent. Net profit was down 95.4 per cent YoY, against JM Financial's loss estimate of ₹8.3 crore.
Vikram Solar's order book reached 8.2 GW after winning 1.7 GW in Q2FY27 and removing around 1 GW of export orders due to US minimum import price rules. Its 9 GW cell plant begins commercial production in March 2027, alongside a 15 GWh BESS expansion by March 2030. JM Financial estimates module output at 3.8 GW, 6.8 GW, and 4.7 GW across FY27–29E, with revenue reaching ₹5,570.8 crore in FY27 and ₹9,339.4 crore in FY28.
 Advt 
 Targets 
In its final call, JM Financial maintained an 'Add' rating on Inox Wind with an unchanged target price of ₹72, valuing it at 11 times September 2028 EBITDA. 
Conversely, the brokerage retained a 'Sell' rating on Vikram Solar with a target price of ₹129 at 5 times September 2028 EBITDA.
